description.zh: HACHIMAN STUDIO 八萬工作室是八萬爸的個人品牌：收錄個人或合作完成的作品（內部系統、AI 工具、互動教材），也提供不收費的概念諮詢。
description.en: HACHIMAN STUDIO is the personal brand of Hachiman's Dad: solo and collaborative work on internal tools, AI tools and interactive learning, plus free concept consulting.

title.zh: 作品集｜HACHIMAN STUDIO 八萬工作室

description.zh: 八萬爸（HACHIMAN STUDIO 八萬工作室）的作品集，個人或合作完成：會議室預約系統、AutoML Workbench、彤靈談心、CS LAB 互動教材等。
description.en: Portfolio of Hachiman's Dad (HACHIMAN STUDIO), solo and collaborative: a meeting-room booking system, AutoML Workbench, TongLing, CS LAB interactive lessons and more.

title.zh: 成長時間線｜HACHIMAN STUDIO 八萬工作室

description.zh: 從 2023 年的第一支爬蟲到現在：依時間排列的作品與成長紀錄，越往下越早。
description.en: From my first crawler in 2023 to today: works and what I learned, newest first.

og_description.zh: 八萬爸的個人作品集：把日常的麻煩做成好用的小工具。有想法卻不知道怎麼做，歡迎來信聊聊。
og_description.en: Hachiman's Dad's portfolio: turning everyday hassles into handy little tools. Have an idea but not sure how to build it? Drop me an email.

lead.zh: HACHIMAN STUDIO 八萬工作室是八萬爸的個人品牌。這裡收錄我在工作之餘，自己或和夥伴一起完成的作品——會議室搶不到、需求文件寫不完、教材讀不懂——把這些日常的麻煩，做成大家願意打開的小工具。
lead.en: HACHIMAN STUDIO is the personal brand of Hachiman's Dad. Here is what I have built outside my day job, on my own or with partners: meeting rooms nobody can book, requirement documents that never end, course material nobody understands. I turn everyday hassles like these into small tools people actually want to open.

badge_text.zh: 有想法不知道怎麼做？歡迎來信
badge_text.en: Not sure how to build yours? Email me

intro.zh: HACHIMAN STUDIO 八萬工作室是我的個人品牌，目前沒有登記營業，也不以營利為目的。工作室只有我一個人：網站上的作品有些是我獨立完成，有些是和同事、朋友合作，每件作品都寫著我負責的部分。
intro.en: HACHIMAN STUDIO is my personal brand. It is not a registered business and not run for profit. The studio is just me: some works here I built alone and some with colleagues and friends, and each one says which part was mine.

background.zh: 從銀行臨櫃起步，做過分行企業金融，現在在數位金融部規劃企業金融的數位產品(非技術職)。2023 年開始自學寫程式，2025 年進入資訊工程碩士在職專班，研究 LLM Agent 的記憶。
background.en: I started at a bank counter, moved into branch corporate banking, and now plan digital products for corporate banking in the digital finance department. I began teaching myself to code in 2023, and in 2025 started a part-time master's in computer science, researching memory for LLM agents.

title.zh: 懂金融業的限制，也能自己做出來
title.en: I know finance's constraints, and I can build within them

text.zh: 熟悉法遵、資安與跨部門流程，主導過 3 項企業金融系統上線；能從法規與業務需求寫到 PRD 與系統分析，也能用 Python、React 親手做出原型。
text.en: I know compliance, security and cross-department processes, and have led 3 corporate banking system launches. I can go from regulations and business needs to PRDs and systems analysis, and build the prototype myself in Python and React.

text.zh: 2023 年從一支爬蟲開始，現在有 3 套內部工具每天在用（合計約 150 人），也在部門裡開 JavaScript 與 Python 課。
text.en: I started with one crawler in 2023. Now 3 internal tools I helped build are used every day by about 150 people in total, and I teach JavaScript and Python classes at work.

text.zh: 在職攻讀資工碩士，精讀 Agent 記憶相關論文並做成論文精讀室；做產品時也守同一套標準：AI 只給建議、來源要能追溯。
text.en: I am studying for a CS master's while working, and turn the agent-memory papers I read closely into the Paper Reading Room. My products follow the same rule: AI only suggests, and every source must be traceable.

name.zh: 輔仁大學 資訊工程學系碩士在職專班
name.en: M.S. in Computer Science and Information Engineering (part-time), Fu Jen Catholic University

name.zh: 淡江大學 財務金融學系
name.en: B.B.A. in Banking and Finance, Tamkang University

note.zh: 2024 – 現在｜企業金融數位產品規劃，主導 3 項系統上線；UAT 自動化（150 個測試模組）；讀書會講師
note.en: 2024 – present · Corporate banking digital product planning; led 3 system launches; UAT automation (150 test modules); book club instructor

name.en: Financial services · Branch deposits and remittances

note.en: 2021 – 2022 · Counter service and account-opening compliance checks

name.zh: 金融業・分行企業金融

note.zh: 2022 – 2024｜企業授信報告、KYC 與洗錢防制審查
note.en: 2022 – 2024 · Corporate credit reports, KYC and anti-money-laundering reviews

text.zh: RAG（BM25 + FAISS 混合檢索）、GraphRAG、AI Agent（ReAct、Tool／Skill）、Ollama 本機部署、RoBERTa、GCN、CNN
text.en: RAG (hybrid BM25 + FAISS), GraphRAG, AI agents (ReAct, tools and skills), local models with Ollama, RoBERTa, GCN

text.zh: Python（FastAPI、Flask）、JavaScript／TypeScript（React、Node.js、Deno）、Java（Spring Boot）、SQL、MongoDB、SQLite
text.en: Python (FastAPI, Flask), JavaScript / TypeScript (React, Node.js, Deno), Java (Spring Boot), SQL, MongoDB, SQLite

text.zh: UAT 測試自動化、UiPath RPA、VBA
text.en: UAT test automation, UiPath RPA, VBA

text.zh: 需求訪談、PRD、系統分析、營運計畫書、法規審查文件
text.en: Requirements interviews, PRDs, systems analysis, operations plans, regulatory filings

research.zh: LLM Agent 的長期記憶：選擇性遺忘、記憶圖譜、跨情境的記憶干擾。
research.en: Long-term memory for LLM agents: selective forgetting, memory graphs and interference between contexts.

research.zh: 我關心的問題是：當對話中斷、記憶過期或互相干擾時，Agent 怎麼還能記得對的事。讀過的論文都整理在論文精讀室。
research.en: The question I care about: when a conversation breaks off, or memories go stale or interfere with each other, how can an agent still remember the right things? The papers I have read are in the Paper Reading Room (in Chinese).

intro.zh: 八萬和歐雷是我家的貓。牠們的個性剛好是我做東西時的兩種狀態，於是就成了這個品牌的名字與吉祥物。
intro.en: Hachiman and Olleh are my cats. Their personalities match the two moods I am in when I build things, so they became the brand's name and mascots.

text.zh: 家裡的橘色虎斑，好奇心旺盛，看到新東西就想撲上去。一想到點子，總是忍不住先動手做出原型再說。
text.en: My orange tabby, endlessly curious, pounces on anything new. When I get an idea, I can't help building a prototype first.

alt.zh: 八萬伏低身體準備撲擊

text.zh: 家裡的白色短毛貓，冷靜細心，什麼都要長時間適應後才放心。也代表我們的產品會循序導入直到接受。
text.en: My white long-haired cat, calm and careful, sniffs everything before trusting it. She reminds me to check data, privacy and details once more before launch.

alt.en: Olleh, a white cat, looking up and smiling

heading.zh: 概念諮詢：有想法，卻不知道怎麼做？
heading.en: Concept consulting: got an idea but not sure how to build it?

intro.zh: 手上有個點子，或是工作上有個麻煩，不知道能不能、該怎麼用程式解決？歡迎來信。我會用自己的經驗幫你想想可行的做法。下面是我比較熟悉、能給出具體建議的範圍。
intro.en: Have an idea, or a problem at work, and wonder whether code could solve it, and how? Email me. I will use my experience to help you think through what could work. These are the areas I know well enough to give concrete advice.

text.zh: 預約、排班、簽核、統計後台——Excel 和群組訊息，能不能換成一個好用的網頁？
text.en: Bookings, rotas, approvals, stats dashboards: could those spreadsheets and group chats become one good web page?

text.zh: AI 能不能接上你的流程？MCP 連接器、知識檢索、本機模型，以及哪裡該保留人工確認。
text.en: Can AI plug into your workflow? MCP connectors, knowledge search, local models, and where a human should still confirm.

text.zh: 把模糊的想法整理成需求、流程圖與可點擊的原型，先看清楚要做什麼、不做什麼。
text.en: Turn a fuzzy idea into requirements, flowcharts and a clickable prototype, so it is clear what to build and what not to.

text.zh: 難懂的知識，怎麼用模擬器、測驗與遊戲化設計，變成可以「玩」懂的內容？
text.en: How can simulators, quizzes and game design turn hard topics into something you learn by playing?

text.zh: 概念諮詢是我的個人興趣，以分享經驗、幫你釐清方向為主，不收費。我會在下班時間回信，可能需要幾天。
text.en: Concept consulting is a personal interest: I share experience and help you find a direction, free of charge. I reply after work hours, so it may take a few days.

title.zh: 超出範圍，歡迎一起合作
title.en: Beyond my scope? Let's team up

text.zh: 諮詢會限制在上面我熟悉的技術範疇；超過的部分我會直接說明，也很歡迎有相關專長的人來一起合作。
text.en: Consulting stays within the technical areas above. If something goes beyond them I will say so plainly, and people with the right skills are very welcome to collaborate.

text.zh: 但請留意這是個人，不是公司：時間與規模都有一定上限，比較適合小型工具或原型，無法承接需要全職投入或長期保固的專案。
text.en: But this is one person, not a company: time and scale are limited. It suits small tools or prototypes, not projects that need full-time work or long-term support.

intro.zh: 點開卡片看詳細內容；部分作品提供可以實際操作的線上示範（資料皆為虛構）。
intro.en: Open a card for details. Some works have a demo you can try, with made-up data. Demos and linked sites are in Chinese.

intro.zh: 不用準備完整的文件，幾句話的描述就夠了。
intro.en: No need for a full document; a few sentences are enough.

text.zh: 想解決什麼、誰會用、現在怎麼做。三五句話就可以。
text.en: What you want to solve, who would use it, how it is done today. A few sentences will do.

text.zh: 我會回信問幾個問題，幫你把想法整理成比較清楚的需求與範圍。
text.en: I reply with a few questions to help shape the idea into clearer requirements and scope.

text.zh: 建議可行的做法、適合的工具或技術，以及可以先試的最小版本。
text.en: Suggested approaches, suitable tools or technology, and the smallest version worth trying first.

text.zh: 剛好是我做得來又有興趣的，可以一起做原型；超出範圍就找夥伴一起來。
text.en: If it is something I can do and enjoy, we can build a prototype together; if it is beyond me, we bring in partners.

text.zh: 用 Python 抓股價、Flask 發 API、MongoDB 做會員系統，一步步把網站做起來。
text.en: Scraping stock prices with Python, serving an API with Flask, a MongoDB member system: building a website step by step.

text.zh: 派對抽座位、MBTI 分組、數位達人激勵平台，以及第一版會議室預約系統。
text.en: Party seat draws, MBTI grouping, a learning-rewards platform and the first meeting-room booking system.

text.zh: MeetBook 加入 LINE 與 AI 助理入口並遷移到 Cloudflare；AutoML Workbench、彤靈談心、CS LAB 陸續推出。
text.en: MeetBook added LINE and AI-assistant access and moved to Cloudflare; AutoML Workbench, TongLing and CS LAB followed.

text.zh: 以家裡的兩隻貓八萬與歐雷為品牌，整理過去的作品，也開始提供概念諮詢。
text.en: Named after my two cats, Hachiman and Olleh, gathering past work and starting concept consulting.

heading.zh: 有想法，卻不知道該怎麼做？
heading.en: Got an idea but not sure how to build it?

text.zh: 不管是一個還沒成形的點子、一個想解決的麻煩，或是好奇 AI 能不能幫上忙，都歡迎來信聊聊。這是我的業餘時間，回覆可能需要幾天，請多包涵。
text.en: A half-formed idea, a hassle you want gone, or curiosity about whether AI could help: all welcome. Write in English or Chinese. This is my spare time, so replies may take a few days.

a.zh: 不收費。這是我的個人興趣，以分享經驗、幫你釐清方向為主，不會提供正式的報價或合約。
a.en: No. It is a personal interest: sharing experience and helping you find a direction. There are no formal quotes or contracts.

q.zh: 可以請你直接幫我做嗎？
q.en: Can you just build it for me?

a.zh: 看情況。小型工具或原型、又剛好在我熟悉的範疇內，可以討論一起做。想談正式的商業合作也可以，但這是個人，時間與規模有一定上限，無法像公司一樣承接大型或需要長期保固的專案。
a.en: It depends. For a small tool or prototype within the areas I know, we can talk about building it together. Formal paid work is possible too, but I am one person with limited time and scale, so I cannot take on large projects or long-term support the way a company can.

q.zh: 超出你熟悉的範圍怎麼辦？
q.en: What if it is outside what you know?

a.zh: 我會直接告訴你，盡量提供可以找的方向；也很歡迎有相關專長的人來一起合作。
a.en: I will tell you plainly and point you in a useful direction where I can. People with the right skills are very welcome to collaborate.

q.zh: 作品都是你一個人做的嗎？
q.en: Did you build all of these alone?

a.zh: 有些是我獨立完成，有些是和同事、朋友合作。每件作品的介紹裡都寫著「我的角色」，就是我負責的部分。
a.en: Some alone, some with colleagues and friends. Each work's details include "My role", the part I was responsible for.

intro.zh: 從 2023 年的第一支爬蟲，到每天有人在用的預約系統。有些是我獨立完成，有些是和同事、朋友合作；點開卡片可以看到每件作品的重點、技術、連結，以及「我的角色」。
intro.en: From my first crawler in 2023 to a booking system people use every day. Some I built alone, some with colleagues and friends. Open a card for highlights, tech, links and "My role". Demos and linked sites are in Chinese.

footnote.zh: ※ 封面為我繪製的示意圖或示範版截圖，畫面中的人名、資料與數字均為虛構。標示「線上示範」的作品是原本介面搭配虛構資料的離線版本，不會連到任何正式環境。
footnote.en: ※ Covers are my own illustrations or screenshots of the demos; all names, data and numbers in them are made up. Works marked "Demo" are offline versions of the original interface with made-up data and never connect to a live system.

intro.zh: 最新的作品在最上面，往下滑會一路回到起點。每件作品旁邊寫著它讓我學到的事（不論是個人還是合作完成）；點開卡片可以看詳細內容與試用連結。
intro.en: The newest work is at the top; scroll down to go all the way back to the start. Next to each work is what it taught me, whether I built it alone or with others. Open a card for details and links.

end_text.en: It all began with one crawler.

text.zh: 把 AI 接進真實流程，同時把作品做成別人也能用的產品：本機優先、可追溯、可維運。
text.en: Connecting AI to real workflows while turning my work into products other people can use: local-first, traceable and maintainable.

text.zh: 開始替同事解決每天的麻煩：預約、活動、學習激勵，第一次有人每天在用我做的東西。
text.en: Solving my colleagues' everyday problems: bookings, events and learning rewards. For the first time, people used something I built every day.

text.zh: 一支爬蟲、一個 Flask 網站——寫程式的起點；年底第一次和夥伴分工，做出選前上線的政見測驗。
text.en: A crawler and a Flask site: where programming started. At the end of the year I first split work with a partner and shipped a policy quiz before the election.

text.zh: 以家裡的兩隻貓八萬與歐雷為品牌，整理三年來個人與合作的作品，也開始提供概念諮詢。
text.en: Named after my two cats, Hachiman and Olleh. I gathered three years of solo and collaborative work and started offering concept consultations.
